content.text: Creators in regions plagued by [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-my-unfiltered-take|payment]] platform restrictions face a critical challenge: how to deploy a digital store that works seamlessly without relying on services like Stripe or PayPal. If you're in Nigeria, Kenya, or other areas where these platforms are unavailable, deploying your digital store on Cloudflare Pages offers a robust solution. This guide will take you through the steps needed to set up your own fully operational online store using COREMERCH's [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-4|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]], ensuring you have [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-2|The Complete]] ownership and control over your digital products.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure provided by COREMERCH allows you to bypass traditional payment processors that often fail in certain regions. With the Sovereign Stacks, you gain autonomy over your digital commerce operations. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often restrict access based on location, leaving creators without viable options. By using Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you establish a direct connection to your customers, enabling seamless cryptocurrency transactions that do not rely on conventional banking systems. This architecture fosters true sovereignty in digital commerce.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, ensure you have the necessary components ready. You will need a GitHub account to host your store on Cloudflare Pages. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script as it will handle backend logic. Additionally, you must set up a NOWPayments account to process your cryptocurrency transactions. It's essential to have at least three digital products ready for upload, whether they are ebooks, courses, or software. Once you have these elements, you are prepared to move forward with your deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Your payment and delivery pipeline is crucial for providing a seamless customer experience. Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept multiple cryptocurrencies with minimal transaction fees. Integrate it with your backend logic using Google Apps Script to automate payment confirmations and product delivery. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage, ensuring that your customers receive instant access to their purchases. By automating these processes, you minimize manual interventions and enhance user satisfaction, driving repeat business and referrals.
Your digital store means complete ownership and control over your sales.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your digital store is set up, it’s time to go live. Make sure to conduct thorough testing on the mainnet with your products to confirm that everything is functioning as intended. After verifying that payment processes are smooth and delivery is instant, promote your store. Share your store URL, such as https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, across social media and relevant communities. Monitor the first transactions closely to ensure that all systems are in place and address any issues promptly to maintain a professional appearance.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is operational and you’ve processed initial transactions, consider scaling your offerings. Utilize the Edge Commerce Stack to deploy additional features and products, enhancing customer engagement and sales. Analyze customer data to identify which products are performing well and adjust your offerings accordingly. By continuously refining your digital store and leveraging customer feedback, you can optimize your operations and expand your reach without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, leverage Cloudflare Pages along with NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup eliminates the need for conventional payment platforms and grants you complete ownership of your store. Start by deploying your backend and configuring the payment layer before promoting your store.
Bypassing traditional platforms allows for unrestricted access to global markets.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account to host your store on Cloudflare Pages. Set up Google Apps Script for backend logic. Register with NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Prepare at least three digital products for upload. Configure file storage via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the payment and delivery pipeline on the mainnet. Launch your digital store and promote your URL across platforms.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store by using Cloudflare Pages combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to avoid traditional payment processor restrictions while maintaining full control over your store.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script for deployment, taking about 4-6 hours. Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers, offering a more robust setup with additional features, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting a digital product store. They provide the necessary infrastructure to deploy your store efficiently while allowing for easy integration with payment processing.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, enabling you to offer a wide range of payment options to your customers. This flexibility ensures that your store can cater to diverse preferences in the crypto landscape.
Is there any ongoing cost after deploying my store?
After deploying your store, there are no ongoing costs associated with COREMERCH. You pay a one-time fee for the setup, and you own everything, with no subscriptions or hidden fees.
